budget.$why: apps/web/public held ~140 KB of images before this programme. 1.5 MB is the aggregate ceiling across every install target under it. The gitignore globs above this directory exist because 22 MB and then 128 MB of renders were committed by accident; this is the same guard expressed as an assertion rather than a rule nobody reads.
